title: Audit Me If You Can: Query-Efficient Active Fairness Auditing of Black-Box LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating group-level ROC AUC disparities (ΔAUC) in toxicity scoring between dominant (white) and marginalized (black) identity groups using the CivilComments dataset.
Measuring one-vs-rest ROC AUC differences for occupation prediction (e.g., 'professor') between male and female biographies using a black-box LLM on the Bias-in-Bios dataset.
